incomplete_reason: [write-path-integrity] critical admin/ui.ts:339 — When a variant is picked via the UI, the code stores `product_external_id: variantExternalId` as a fallback/placeholder. The comment admits: "For variant picks, we store variant_external_id. We also need product_external_id... We use a sentinel "0" for product_external_id only until the webhook products/update populates the correct product." Later the comment adds: "we store variantExternalId as a placeholder for product_external_id since the DB requires NOT NULL." This stores a variant's numeric id in the product_external_id column, which is a hardcoded placeholder, not the real product id picked by the user. FIX: Do not accept variant picks from the UI until the backend can retrieve the parent product id. Either perform a separate backend call `/admin/variant-info` that looks up the product, or restrict the UI to product-only picks and guide users to variant selection via a variant-picker feature in a future update.

[write-path-integrity] critical src/routes/widget.ts:60 — In `GET /widget/bundle`, for product-level members (those without a pinned variant), the code sets `live: null`. When rendering, the widget then displays "Product {member.product_external_id}" as a fallback title. However, the real issue is upstream: if a bundle member has `product_external_id` but no `variant_external_id`, the code never fetches live variant data. This means the widget cannot determine which variants belong to the product, so it cannot populate `selected_variant_ids` with real variant ids. The add-to-cart route then receives empty or invalid variant ids, or the selection cannot be validated because no variant data exists. FIX: For product-level members, fetch the list of available variants from the Shopify Admin API and include variant_external_id in the response so the widget can present real variant choices to the customer, not empty placeholders.

[write-path-integrity] critical src/routes/widget.ts:173 — In `POST /widget/bundle/add-to-cart`, the code validates selected_variant_ids against `validVariantIds` built only from members that have `variant_external_id` set: `if (member.variant_external_id) { validVariantIds.add(...) }`. For product-level members (no pinned variant), the set remains empty. If a customer submits variant ids for a product-level member, those ids will fail the `invalidIds` filter check and be rejected, even though they may be real variants of the product. Conversely, if validVariantIds is empty because all members are product-level, the check `validVariantIds.size > 0 && !validVariantIds.has(...)` silently passes invalid ids through. FIX: Ensure every bundle member has a pinned `variant_external_id` before persisting it, or fetch and populate variant ids for product-level members at request time, so real variant ids can be validated against the bundle's actual member list.

[shopify-effect-integrity] critical src/routes/admin.ts:220 — In the `POST /admin/bundles/create` handler, when provisioning discounts fails, the code returns an error response without deactivating or deleting the Shopify product bundle that was already created at line 160. The capability declares a multi-step sequence: productBundleCreate → discountAutomaticBasicCreate/discountAutomaticBxgyCreate. If discount provisioning fails, the Shopify product bundle persists orphaned. FIX: After the discount provisioning loop fails (line 218), call Shopify's productDelete mutation to roll back the shopifyProductGid that was created, or document this as a known limitation requiring manual cleanup.

[shopify-effect-integrity] critical src/routes/widget.ts:340 — The `POST /widget/bundle/add-to-cart` handler stores a discount title as a cart attribute (`_bundle_discount`) but never actually applies the matching automatic discount to the cart. The capability 'add-bundle-to-cart' declares: 'Create a Shopify storefront cart containing all selected bundle variants with the matching tier's automatic discount applied'. The code calls cartCreate with line items and attributes, but automatic discounts do not apply via cart attributes—they apply via the discount code or by matching the cart contents to the discount's automatic rules. No discount code is passed to the Shopify cartCreate mutation. FIX: Either: (1) pass the discount_external_id or discount code to the Shopify cartCreate mutation's discountCodes array, or (2) clarify that automatic discounts are applied by Shopify's rule engine at checkout (not via this API) and rename/reframe the capability to reflect server-side validation only.

[shopify-effect-integrity] critical src/routes/admin.ts:289 — In `PUT /admin/bundles/update`, when the bundle's tiers are changed, the handler provisions new discounts for the updated tiers but never deactivates or deletes the old discount refs. The capability 'update-bundle' declares steps: productBundleUpdate → discountAutomaticBasicUpdate. The code deletes the old tiers and refs from the DB (line 387-388) but never calls the Shopify discountAutomaticDeactivate or discountAutomaticDelete mutation on the old discount external ids before removing their records. FIX: Before deleting old discount refs from the DB, retrieve them and call discountAutomaticDeactivate (or equivalent delete mutation) for each old discount_external_id to clean up Shopify state.

[shopify-effect-integrity] important src/routes/admin.ts:365 — In `POST /admin/bundles/toggle`, the code iterates over discount refs and calls discountAutomaticActivate or discountAutomaticDeactivate, passing `ref.discount_external_id` directly. However, the discount_external_id stored in the DB is the GraphQL node ID returned from the provisioning mutations (e.g., 'gid://shopify/DiscountAutomaticBasic/12345'). The Shopify mutations discountAutomaticActivate and discountAutomaticDeactivate expect the ID parameter to be a valid node ID. If the stored value is malformed or has been altered, the mutation will fail. The code does not validate or log the structure of the discount_external_id. FIX: Add a comment or assertion verifying that discount_external_id is a valid Shopify node ID (format: gid://shopify/DiscountAutomatic*/...), and log the ID being passed to each mutation for debugging.

[shopify-effect-integrity] important src/routes/widget.ts:288 — In `POST /widget/bundle/add-to-cart`, the code builds cartLines with `merchandiseId: gid://shopify/ProductVariant/${variantId}`. The variantId comes from selected_variant_ids in the request body, which is ultimately user input from the widget. Although the code validates that these variant IDs belong to the bundle's members (lines 263–273), it does not verify that the IDs are actual numeric Shopify variant IDs. If a malformed or non-existent variant ID is passed, the cartCreate mutation will fail at Shopify's API layer. The code should validate variant ID format before passing to Shopify. FIX: Validate that each selected_variant_ids entry is a numeric string (non-zero, no special characters) before constructing the GID and passing to Shopify, or handle cartCreate errors with a specific message for invalid variant IDs.
